about: Registry for scripts/local_llm.py. Model metadata is public; path and archive_path are supplied by config/local_llm_models.local.json below LSS_PRIVATE_ROOT. Entries without path are unavailable. archive_only entries are excluded from default hot-path checks. size_bytes must match the file. args contains model-specific llama-server flags; the runner owns model, endpoint, context, f16 K/V cache and kind flags. ram_gb is the admission working-set estimate, plus a shared 4 GB reserve. request is merged into chat requests. Historical measurements are observations, not guarantees for another machine.

qwen3.5-4b.notes: Experimental reviewed developer drafts; no autonomous application or quality decisions. CPU 4096-context/F16-cache working-set peak 4.74 GB on two historical drafts; admission budgets 5 GB plus the shared reserve. GPU steady working set is not inferred from this CPU measurement.

gpt-oss-20b.notes: Fastest fitting is n-cpu-moe 5 (52 t/s) but peaks near the 16 GB limit when the desktop uses 3.3 GB; 6 is the safe choice. Cold HDD load 167 s, warm 5-20 s. Invents ids on truncated logs: never an id source. The recorded 167-second cold load belongs to an archive route; it does not describe active SSD startup.

qwen3.6-35b-a3b.notes: Drove system free RAM to 63 MB on the 32 GB PC: run only with nothing else heavy open. Effective cold start (health to first useful answer) 5-6 min. Zero hallucinated ids in the pytest triage test.
